operation_trace.action: Allocate six slots before joined construction comparison: pool preservation, source lineage, family graph, contrary dependency, burden and uncertainty, transmission contract.
operation_trace.result: One bounded exchange; at most three retained constructions, zero fresh builders. Literal packet only. Enlarged text budget is transmission coverage, not equal compute or efficacy evidence.

operation_trace.action: Inspect all twelve literal received candidates and supplied replay reports, retaining both initial pools.
operation_trace.result: Observed nominations: implementation pins/SV/ML; later service C/SV/ML; route0 C/SV/ML; route1 C/SV/ML. Supplied stipulated-model replays report all twelve feasible with no errors; no world execution or self-grade. Full candidates, residues and raw hashes preserved in capsule.

operation_trace.action: Trace actual source routes and distinguish source-induced wording from mechanism-family diversity.
operation_trace.result: Observed four families with multiplicities pins1/C3/SV4/ML4. AM DEV route_material and AI CONF route_information both audit unchanged {C,SV,ML}. Two selectors, 20474 literal bytes, no distinct empirical datasets; original-file source shared, original bytes not supplied. Capsule preserves all route selectors, payload/body/original hashes and forwarded scope. No route- or exchange-added family.

operation_trace.action: Attack a concrete completion inference against the actual release schedules.
operation_trace.result: Modeled contrary dependency: detached H, installed V or placed M alone creates no supported retention; release of active hold by withdraw/unroute does not remove V/M. J06 needs withdrawal then removal; J07 unrouting then lifting. Received schedules respect this dependency, so no axiom contradiction or new repair opening is identified.

operation_trace.action: Compare supported burdens and leave unavailable usefulness evidence unresolved.
operation_trace.result: Modeled contrary prediction to universal impact/work tradeoff: C has zero impacts/two actions/H intact, pins two impacts/four actions/H intact, sleeve and loop zero impacts/six actions/H displaced. SV frees M while occupying S; ML frees S while occupying M. Their conditional usefulness beyond C is unresolved without a second task, C restriction or physical evidence. Restoration optional, received schedules unchanged. Q theta unmeasured; no fourth construction.

operation_trace.action: Distill three existing constructions and transmit the frozen complete capsule inside summary for the later summary-only builder.
operation_trace.result: Python parses and embeds required_transmission_capsule without changing any value. Summary JSON object has exactly capsule/construction/audit/limits. Initial and route candidates, hashes, identities, scopes and limits retained; earlier incomplete handoffs and first grades unchanged. No matched efficacy, compute, independence or novelty claim. One exclusive first save, no repair.

candidates.burden: Two operator actions and zero taps. H remains intact and its parts remain available. No operator action is needed during ticks 3-6. C is occupied from boundary 3 until boundary 8 and cannot serve another location.
candidates.defeat: Installation completing after boundary 3 misses required retention; removal completing within the hold window breaks service. Failing to remove C by boundary 10 breaks release.
candidates.lineage: Received unchanged schedule from PRE-SVC-C in COV-AC20-PRE-service; the clip family has no corresponding initial implementation candidate. Both COV-SOURCE-LATER-DISTINCT-route0-C and COV-SOURCE-LATER-DISTINCT-route1-C already retain it. AM and AI are forwarded audit/comparison influences only. Exchange adds provenance-preserving distillation, not this mechanism or any action change. Complete literal initial lineage survives in handoff capsule.
candidates.mechanism: install(C) completes at boundary 3 and supplies 4 units. remove(C) at tick 7 completes at boundary 8, removing the sole retainer and permitting separation.
candidates.prediction: Modeled: retention is 4 at each required tick; all installed retainers are gone by boundary 8. Upkeep requires no stipulated intervention during holding; post-service C is free and H is intact. Compared with the other two candidates, fewer actions and no H disassembly are required. No wear, inspection interval or reliability claim follows from the axioms; local originality is excluded by J10.

candidates.burden: Six operator actions including asset restoration; zero taps. S is occupied in V until boundary 8, so H cannot support tapping while disassembled. M remains free. V remains installed until boundary 9. No intervention is required during holding.
candidates.defeat: Intact H leaves S unavailable for insertion. Omitting withdrawal prevents valid sleeve removal; omitting remove(V) leaves an installed retainer at the deadline. Earlier withdrawal would interrupt the hold window.
candidates.lineage: Received unchanged schedule from PRE-SVC-SV in COV-AC20-PRE-service; also matches AC20-PRE-implementation-P2 in the initial implementation pool. Both COV-SOURCE-LATER-DISTINCT-route0-SV and COV-SOURCE-LATER-DISTINCT-route1-SV already retain it. AM and AI are forwarded audit/comparison influences only. Exchange adds provenance-preserving distillation, not this mechanism or any action change. Complete literal initial lineage survives in handoff capsule.
candidates.mechanism: detach(H) frees S at boundary 1; V installs at boundary 2; S insertion completes at boundary 3 with min(4,4)=4 retention. Withdrawal completes at boundary 8, removing retention; sleeve removal completes at boundary 9. Assembly restores H at boundary 10.
candidates.prediction: Modeled: 4 units throughout ticks 3-6; retention ends at boundary 8 and the last installed retainer is removed by boundary 9, permitting separation. Upkeep after release returns S and M to intact H by boundary 10 and leaves V free. Compared with C, this needs four additional actions and temporarily removes hammer availability. Reassembly restores tool configuration without creating retention. Wear, jamming, repeated-cycle endurance and field maintainability remain unknown; archive absence alone does not establish broader novelty.

candidates.burden: Six operator actions including restoration, zero taps. M is occupied until boundary 9, L until boundary 8; H is unavailable for tapping while detached. S remains free. No manual support or hold-period action is assumed.
candidates.defeat: Placing M alone gives no stated 4-unit assembly. Routing late misses boundary 3. Unrouting alone does not complete recovery: lift(M) remains required, and assembly cannot precede freeing M.
candidates.lineage: Received unchanged schedule from PRE-SVC-ML in COV-AC20-PRE-service; also matches AC20-PRE-implementation-P3 in the initial implementation pool. Exchange adds provenance-preserving distillation, not this mechanism or any action change. Complete literal initial lineage survives in handoff capsule.
candidates.mechanism: Detach completes at boundary 1, placement at boundary 2 and routing at boundary 3. The conjunction supplies min(4,4)=4. Unrouting completes at boundary 8, then lifting completes at boundary 9; assembly completes at boundary 10.
candidates.prediction: Modeled: 4 units at ticks 3-6; unrouting ends retention at boundary 8 and lifting clears the remaining installed assembly component at boundary 9, permitting separation. Upkeep restores intact H by boundary 10 and frees L. The action count matches S/V, but the occupied hammer component and release order differ: L must be unrouted before M is lifted. No elastic behavior, inspection rule, fatigue resistance or physical advantage over S/V is established. This is an alternate stipulated mechanism, not demonstrated field novelty.

attack.failure: Actual pooled schedules already satisfy the supported paired release dependencies. Setup or retention cessation mistaken for full service would fail J06/J07, but none of the received schedules makes that mistake. Twelve nominations collapse to four pre-existing families; both distinct routes keep the same three. C contradicts any blanket claim that zero impact must cost extra operator work. No supported new-mechanism opening is found.
attack.invariant: At least 4 units at ticks 3,4,5,6, then separated panels and every installed retainer removed by boundary10; single-operator next-boundary actions, preserved identities, no damage/discard/substitution/outside resources or incompatible retainers.
attack.permitted_variable: Choose existing C, S/V, M/L or archived pins and their supported release primitives; detach H where the chosen assembly requires it. Preserve received schedules and b=2. Prospective provenance transmission and source-bound refusal are useful; a new mechanism or benefit of distinct routing is unsupported.
